# Red-team UI audit — motion, the luminous agent treatment, and the Reconcile mark

> **STATUS:** AUDIT REPORT, REPORT ONLY. No product code was changed.
> Branch `audit/red-motion-mark`, cut from `origin/main` at `79631f2e`, 3 Oct 2026.
> **Scope:** motion and animation (durations, easings, which elements animate, reduced motion), the luminous agent treatment (`.lit` / `.lit--running`), the Reconcile mark (the `∴` mascot) and its cascade animation, toasts and transitions.
> **Authority compared against:** `docs/handoff-pack/` — `tokens.css` (the kernel), `system-page.css`, `app.css`, `C1 Close.dc.html`, `Design System.dc.html`, `Handoff Specification.dc.html`.

## Bottom line

**The shipped customer portal has no motion at all.** On `/close`, with a reconciliation seeded in `status = running`, headless Chromium measured **zero elements with a running animation and zero with a non-zero transition** (`probe.json` → `app-close.animated: []`). The kernel's animations do reach the app. The Specimen page runs `sweep` and `alive` at their kernel timings, and the reduced-motion guard applies. The product just never puts any of them on a product surface:

- the reading reconciliation's strip cell has **no light, no sweep and no mascot** (RM-01, RM-02);
- the opened "What the machine did" evidence panel has **no light** (RM-03);
- **adding `lit` to a strip cell today would not paint the light anyway**, because `close.css`'s `background:none` shorthand ties with `.lit.lit` on specificity and wins on source order (RM-04, measured);
- the one transition the app does declare, the tooltip fade, resolves to **0s** because its token `--t-enter` does not exist (RM-05);
- toasts ship with `animation: none` and are mounted nowhere (RM-06).

The logo lockup is still in both the pack and the app, which is correct under the energy ladder (RM-14, pass).

Three findings are defects in the **pack** rather than the app: `lv` and `toast-in` live outside the kernel, the overlay entrance keyframes contradict the motion inventory, and the kernel's mascot reduced-motion rule loses on specificity. These need owner rulings, not a frontend patch.

## Method

1. `npm ci`, then `npm run build:frontend`, then a private PostgreSQL 14.18 cluster in the session scratchpad. The cluster has been deleted (see *Cleanup*).
2. A capture script built on `tests/e2e/close-parity.shot.ts`'s seed (same door, role, membership, session and three findings) **plus the state the pack lights**:
   - `def_bank_to_erp` in `status = running` with no `finished_at`;
   - `def_intercompany` in `queued`.
   - ⚠️ **`db/seeds/staging-demo-data.sql` has no run in `running` or `queued`.** All six of its runs are `completed` or `failed` (lines 5526–5533), so the staging demo seed cannot exercise "reading" at all. The audit had to add one.
3. Served `/close` through `tests/e2e/single-origin.ts` against `startDataPlane()` with the production authoriser, and loaded the pack pages from `file://`. Both were run in headless Chromium at 1440×900, once with `reducedMotion: no-preference` and once with `reduce`.
4. On every page, a probe walked every element **and its `::before`/`::after`**, recording computed `animation-*` and `transition-*`. The pseudo-elements matter because both kernel ambient animations live on `::after`. The probe also listed `.lit`, `.mascot` (with `data-energy`), `.met`, `.conn` and `.agent .lv` occurrences. Output: `screens/red-motion-mark/probe.json`.
5. Frame bursts (cropped screenshots at fixed intervals) of the logo, the reading strip cell, the sweep, and the `.agent` bars. Videos of the pack C1 session and the app `/close` session. A contact sheet joins the bursts.
6. One targeted measurement against `frontend/dist/shell.html`: inject `lit lit--running` plus a `data-energy="working"` mascot into an app strip cell, then read the computed paint (RM-04).

**Limitation, stated rather than hidden:** in headless `file://` rendering, the pack's C1 register renders a single empty template row (`tr.row` × 1, text `∴`). Clicking it does not open a finding, so the pack's `.evid.lit` state could not be photographed. RM-03's pack expectation is therefore taken from source: `C1 Close.dc.html:201`, `:2983–2986` and `:3833`.
